reader.reads: Every place in English and every thesis beside its formula; scan pages 3, 4, 34 and 35 word by word.

william-morris.the-decorative-arts:art-o.note: The place says men have 'more or less striven' at all times; both theses omit 'more or less' and state the striving without that qualification.

william-morris.the-decorative-arts:pleas.note: The place calls 'to give people pleasure' the two offices or uses of decoration; both theses assert that decoration gives this pleasure, rather than stating the offices as the place does.

summary: The passages on houses and exclusive art support their theses, and the four pages read as the packet. The first two theses omit a qualification and turn an office into an assertion of effect.
